detail.longDescription: I am looking to search through my entire repo for changes to a specific line. For example the line of code might be var code = "ABC"; Later in the code it was changed to var code = "DEF"; I want to search for this, but only find changes, not new files. There are a number of files that have this same code snippet, so we want to exclude new instances of the file. So if I do git log -S "var code =" That is wrong as it includes new files, not just changes.
